misconception: Defend only protects the Dahan; the land still takes the Invaders' full Damage (and gets Blight).
rulebook: p18 Defend: "reduce the total amount of Damage they do by N"; p9 "Damage is done both to the land and Dahan."
notes: The FAQ answer adds that some Powers (Concealing Shadows) protect only the Dahan; this is the misconception that Defend in general works that way.
